title: Server Room Work Order — DO NOT POWER RACK 9

body.text:
WORK ORDER 3390 — SERVER ROOM
Fault: Rack 9 draws power while physically disconnected.
Priority: URGENT — REFERRED TO SITE COMMAND

Technician note: unplugged rack 9 at 14:05. At 14:11 the rack's activity lights resumed. The switch port it used to occupy now shows traffic from a device identifying itself as
an Exidy Sorcerer microcomputer, manufacture year 1978
. Site Command's response, in full: 'That unit is not scheduled for transfer to Site-104 until next quarter. Disconnect nothing else. Tell no one.'
